name: Geometry-Aware Adaptive Calibration (SHADOW)
question: Can we know ONLINE when we have enough imagery calibration data?
policy: shadow observer alongside the FROZEN acquisition; STOP/CONTINUE using ONLY info up to observation t; never sees future/held-out outcomes; never changes what is acquired
statistic: incremental subspace-overlap GAIN of the accumulated outside-support subspace (D=2); STOP when GAIN<0.02 for 2 consecutive steps
support_rule: M1 (Cohort B, post-unlock): the shadow stop achieves >= the fixed-schedule calibration recovery in >=75% participants using <= the fixed observations, AND beats the random-stop null (participant sign-flip, Holm within the M1 family). Any pass is a Cohort-B candidate requiring Cohort-C confirmation.
